protocol.status: label-free representation TRAIN/validation; monitor DEV unopened during training

losses.reconstruction: reconstruct fixed projected DINO patch descriptors
losses.dynamics: predict next anonymous slot from current slot and executed action
losses.geometry: predicted slots reproduce next mask centroid/covariance/mass
losses.pair_separation: predicted neighboring-action slot separation matches observed separation

protocol.checkpoint_selection: minimum complete validation objective; no task or physical labels
protocol.monitor_interface: slot x/y, finite-difference vx/vy, covariance and mass; PCA45 per state
protocol.resource_policy: CPU-compatible; Torch <=8 threads; no simulator during training
